# Planet X Devs

> Planet X Devs is a white-label web development partner for marketing and digital agencies, based in Lakeway / Austin, TX and serving agencies worldwide. We build fast, custom websites (primarily Next.js and React) that clients can manage themselves, and we support the WordPress sites agencies already manage — all delivered under the agency's brand.

## What we do

- **Custom website development**: Hand-coded Next.js and React sites, or client-friendly CMS builds that non-technical clients can manage themselves. Includes custom scroll animations and interactions with GSAP.
- **White-label agency partnership**: We work invisibly behind the scenes. Every deliverable is branded as the agency's work, and we only talk to the agency's clients if the agency wants us to.
- **E-commerce development**: Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless commerce builds and migrations.
- **Performance optimization**: Core Web Vitals and page-speed audits and fixes.
- **SEO-safe migrations**: Moving a site to a new platform or design without losing its rankings — URL mapping and 301 redirects, metadata and structured data carried over, sitemap resubmission, and post-launch crawl monitoring.
- **WordPress support & migrations**: Performance, security, updates, fixes, and migrations for existing WordPress sites, including migrations off WordPress onto faster custom builds. We lead with custom builds, and build new WordPress sites only when a client specifically needs one.
- **Emergency support & maintenance**: 4-hour response for site emergencies, plus ongoing maintenance plans.

## Key facts

- Team: Nathaniel Mays (Founder & Lead Developer, senior web developer, 4+ years) and Sebastian Perrone (Frontend Developer, 4+ years)
- Location: Lakeway / Austin, TX, USA; serves marketing agencies worldwide
- Taking clients since 2024; Planet X Devs officially founded in 2025
- Response times: every request answered within 24 hours; emergencies within 4 hours
- Engagement models: project-based quotes (delivered within 24 hours) or monthly partnership retainers
- Monthly partnership plans start at $900–1,100/month for 25 hours of white-label development
- 100% white-label; no long-term contracts required

## Featured work

- [Lodestar](https://www.planetxdevs.com/portfolio/lodestar): A Next.js progressive web app that scores every US county and 80,000+ neighborhood-sized areas against your own priorities, with a choropleth map and a Python data pipeline that rebuilds monthly.
- [Start Where We Are Festival](https://www.planetxdevs.com/portfolio/start-where-we-are-festival): A pro-bono custom Next.js and React site for a grassroots Boston-area music and sustainability festival, with GiveButter, Google Maps, and Kit integrations.
- [Peak Performance Medical Center](https://www.planetxdevs.com/portfolio/peak-performance-medical): A conversion-focused WordPress (Elementor) site with service-line pages and a lead-capture funnel for a Florida health clinic.
- Full portfolio: https://www.planetxdevs.com/portfolio
